title: Joe's Upper Body
author: Joe Jayakumar
desc: I'm playing soccer weekly, knees hurt and must deal with aches and pains. So this program keeps my upper body progressing while lower body gets whatever is needed based on where I'm at that week.

ex.note: For set 2-4, use 85% of weight of 1st set. Use a controlled eccenstric, and full pause each rep, do not rest at the bottom of each rep. 3 min rest.
Different rear delt iso from Upper 2. For set 2-3, match 1st set reps with myo reps as closely as possible.

ss.note: Rest 90s
Short Head Isolation. AMRAP first set, do 2/3 the reps on sets 2 and 3 (beat your reps on sets 2 and 3 each week, add weight once all 3 match week 1 AMRAP). 90s rest.

ex.note: Side Delt Isolation. AMRAP first set, do 2/3 the reps on sets 2 and 3 (beat your reps on sets 2 and 3 each week, add weight once all 3 match week 1 AMRAP). 90s rest.
Rest 2 min
For set 2-4, use 85% of weight of 1st set. Incline Press OR Overhead Press of Choice OR Horizontal Press of Choice
Different rear delt iso from Upper 1. For set 2-3, match 1st set reps with myo reps as closely as possible.

ss.note: Bicep exercise of choice. 90 sec seconds between sets.

ex.note: Side Delt iso. AMRAP first set, do 2/3 the reps on sets 2 and 3(beat your set 2 and 3 reps each week, add weight once all 3 sets match your week 1 AMRAP). Rest 90s between sets.
